name: ai-working-lab-tools
description: Writing and research tools for RW Institute's AI Working Labs: catch AI slop and keep source checks honest.

plugins.name: rw-humanize
plugins.description: Catch AI slop in writing at three depths (word choice, craft, story structure) and make the assistant show which sources it actually checked before it says it checked everywhere.

plugins.name: lab-coach
plugins.description: PROTOTYPE. A build-first coach for lab participants: start with a real task, get to a working result fast, and explain each concept only when the person runs into it.
